news.title: Larkin scores in return to lineup as Red Wings deal Senators 1st loss of the season 5-3
news.ruTitle: Ларкин забивает, вернувшись в состав, а «Ред Уингз» нанесли сенаторам первое поражение в сезоне 5–3
news.description: — Dylan Larkin scored in his first game since asking for a trade, helping the Detroit Red Wings to a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Tuesday night.

news.title: Amid trade request, Dylan Larkin scores in Red Wings' win
news.ruTitle: На фоне запроса на обмен Дилан Ларкин забил гол в победе «Ред Уингз»
news.description: Cheered by the same crowd that booed him last week, Dylan Larkin played for Red Wings for the first time since asking for a trade, and scored 13 minutes into his return Tuesday, as Detroit posted a 5-3 win over the Ottawa Senators at Little Caesars Arena.

news.title: Owen Power scores in OT and Sabers rally from 2 goals down to beat Wild 3-2
news.ruTitle: Оуэн Пауэр забивает в овертайме и розыгрыше «Сэйбрз» со счетом 2 гола и побеждает «Уайлд» со счетом 3–2.
news.description: — Owen Power scored 4:22 into overtime and the Buffalo Sabres rallied from a two-goal deficit to beat the Minnesota Wild 3-2 on Tuesday night.

news.title: Maple Leafs' Gavin McKenna has goal, assist against Predators
news.ruTitle: Игрок «Мэйпл Лифс» Гэвин МакКенна забил гол и сделал результативную передачу в матче с «Хищниками»
news.description: No. 1 draft pick Gavin McKenna scored his first NHL goal with the Maple Leafs on Tuesday night.

news.title: Winless Philadelphia Flyers add depth in Michael Bunting
news.ruTitle: Без побед «Филадельфия Флайерз» добавили глубины Майклу Бантингу
news.description: The winless Philadelphia Flyers added to their forward group Tuesday, signing veteran winger Michael Bunting, 30, in the hopes that he can give them a spark following some alarming early season struggles, including scoring just five goals in four games.

news.title: Alex Ovechkin's retirement news sparks notable ticket price hike
news.ruTitle: Новости о завершении карьеры Алексея Овечкина вызвали заметный рост цен на билеты
news.description: Ever since the NHL's all-time goals leader announced his retirement, ticket prices to Capitals games have been soaring -- and not just for home games.

news.title: Scoreless Leafs rookie McKenna on slow start: 'Still believe in myself'
news.ruTitle: Нулевой по счету новичок «Лифс» Маккенна о медленном старте: «Все еще верю в себя»
news.description: Maple Leafs rookie Gavin McKenna is experiencing first-hand the pressure of being a first overall pick -- one who still hasn't scored an NHL point.

news.title: Avalanche's Logan O'Connor, Zachary L'Heureux may return on trip
news.ruTitle: Игроки Avalanche Логан О'Коннор и Закари Л'Эрё могут вернуться в поездку
news.description: Banged-up Colorado forwards Logan O'Connor and Zachary L'Heureux could make their season debuts this week during a two-game road swing.

news.title: Stanley Cup odds: Florida Panthers, Carolina Hurricanes lead favorites
news.ruTitle: Шансы на Кубок Стэнли: «Флорида Пантерз» и «Каролина Харрикейнз» — фавориты
news.description: The Florida Panthers, Carolina Hurricanes and Colorado Avalanche are favorites to win the 2027 Stanley Cup.

news.title: Hits, blocks and consistency: The high floor fantasy hockey players available
news.ruTitle: Удары, блоки и стабильность: доступны фэнтези-хоккеисты высокого уровня
news.description: Hits plus blocked shots with a dash of power-play time could be the recipe for fantasy hockey success.

news.title: Panthers' Aleksander Barkov avoids surgery; out 6-8 weeks
news.ruTitle: Александр Барков из «Пантерс» избежал операции; срок 6-8 недель
news.description: Panthers captain Aleksander Barkov got good news on his lower-body injury as he won't need surgery, but will miss six to eight weeks.

news.title: Dylan Larkin to debut for Red Wings despite demanding trade
news.ruTitle: Дилан Ларкин дебютирует за «Ред Уингз», несмотря на требование обмена
news.description: Red Wings center Dylan Larkin, 30, is expected to make his season debut Tuesday night against the Senators after demanding a trade in the off-season.
